title: Kanban view has no fallback lane for records with an empty group-field value — a board grouped by a new field shows "no cards" in every lane while the footer counts 20 records
body:
Provenance: split from objectstack-ai/cloud#1818 (filed by the maintainer from the two-plane rig, pins 8c822893/7a5da141, scenario battle R7) by the repo:cloud execution seat (objectstack#6026, session `session_01EzWYDkwr6WEwDGhMH1Jzuq`, R30). Filed here under the seam rule — the fix lands in **objectui** (`plugin-kanban`), which is outside the filing seat's session scope; **named reader: central triage**, to route/transfer to the objectui execution seat.

## Measured behavior (maintainer's rig, verbatim from the source card, untranslated)

> build agent 给既有客户表加「客户等级」(A/B/C) 字段并新建按等级分组的看板,两样都建成(视图 kind=kanban,挂在 cepy_customer 上,现有视图保留)。但打开看板:**A/B/C 三列全部「暂无卡片」,而页脚写着 20 条记录**——存量 20 个客户的新字段全为空,看板没有「未设置/未分组」泳道,整批记录在该视图里隐身。

## The defect

Records whose group-field value is empty are simply absent from every lane, while the footer's record count includes them — a silent-hiding + contradictory-count combination. Any kanban grouped by a newly added field hits this on day one (existing records necessarily have no value).

## Fix direction (from the source card)

Group records with an empty group value into a fallback lane (「未设置」/"Not set"), or at minimum render an in-view notice "N records not shown because the group field is empty". Either ends the silent hiding; the fallback lane also makes the records reachable/draggable.

Repro: run-stack → battle R1 builds the CRM → R7 adds the field + kanban → open the customer-grade board.

Sibling (builder-side disclosure half): filed separately in this repo — see the cross-reference comment on cloud#1818.
